acceptanceCriteria: Both LCP-V0-008 tests (cmd/corvint local_completion_event_test.go TestDogfoodEventStrictInputAndDeadline/LCP-V0-008_expiry_does_not_wait_for_an_uncancellable_read and local_completion_claude_test.go TestClaudeNativeDogfoodLifecycle/LCP-V0-008 first Stop) are diagnosed: test timing assumption vs product classification defect (expiry reported as dogfood-event-input-unavailable instead of a time-bound code).
Under contention (>=32 CPU burners), BASE vs fixed failure counts are recorded and the fixed tests pass every run without widening a product deadline; one mutation per test makes it fail.
If the product classifies an expired read as input-unavailable, the LCP spec and code report the time bound and the requirement trace is updated.
body: Observed 2026-10-15 in two full-gate closeouts under host load 20-115 on darwin. (1) V1-0285 full-gate (merge 2814af65b, evidence fd4cef2f, 04:17-06:11Z): local_completion_event_test.go:172 'expired event was not reported as a time bound: {"code": "dogfood-event-input-unavailable", ...}'. (2) V1-0253 full-gate (merge 803037715, evidence 723ebd77, 04:20-04:22Z): local_completion_claude_test.go:37 'first Stop did not block' via the dogfood-event-deadline fallback. Each failure costs a ~2h serialized full gate and blocks ticket closeouts. Related to V1-1120 (product Stop fail-open under load) but this is the test-side gate blocker.
title: LCP-V0-008 deadline tests fail full-gate under host load (expired read reported as input-unavailable; first Stop not blocked)
